strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
What a luuuvely planet this is.
But once the great Butcher gets to it, it'll be a dead planet in no time!
Ho-hohohoho!
Hyoho? What's this, a barrier?
You think this'll stop my Bandock?
This is the point. ...Hm?
Ho?
What is this robot... no, is it a battleship!?
What is that! Talk about tacky!
Speaking from my aesthetic sense... it's actually kinda nice.
That's weird.
Save the chatter! Captain, I'm launching!
All hands, launch. ...Stay alert.
Fuhyoho!? What're these teeny little things?
It's bigger than I thought, Captain.
Yes. But that means it can't turn well.
Then let's run rings around it!
Hohho, how amusing. I'll take you on.
With my Mecha Boosts, that is!
Hm, what are these!?
More of them... a whole bunch of strange-looking robots...
Hostile intent... so it's a new enemy! We can't let it descend to Earth!
Don't be fooled by their looks! All units, commence attack!
What a nuisance! Never mind 'em, keep descending!
Huh, it's running!?
No good, we can't catch it!
Damn, it's descending...!
Captain Bright! The Spazer can handle atmospheric entry. I'll...!
...No, Umon. If we lose the Grendizer now, we can't win this fight.
Leave it to the Gandor team on the surface.
...It can't be helped. Londo Bell will hold position.
If any enemies remain, don't let any more of them reach Earth!
So frustrating, really.
Kyosuke... don't you lose to that thing, okay?
There ya are! Now I've got ya!
I'll show ya what happens when ya pick a fight with us Gyandler!
That's...!? The mysterious army that appeared in the colony belt!?
What did they say!?
I couldn't quite catch it, but Gyan... something...
Hyo? What's this, space is noisy too?
But! Anything that throws those pesky humans into chaos suits me!
Hooo-hohohoho!
Huh? What's with that butt-ugly battleship?
Whatever. We're only after the punks who mocked us last time!
What is going on! In a situation like this...!
Seriously! That's what people call not reading the room!
Quit copyin' Rom, of all people!
Last time, thanks to that guy, we had to turn tail,
...but not this time! Get 'em!
Rom...? So there is a force opposing this army...
Is that the absurd bunch from before? Blast...!
What's with this power! This ain't good!
Finish it...!
Folks fightin' back, Rom pokin' his nose in...
This is the pits! Retreat, retreeeat!
Phew...
What a troublemaker.
...But their combat ability is nothing to sneer at. We must identify them soon.
Same goes for that guy on the bridge. He didn't show up this time, though...
I'd like to believe he's no enemy...
But as far as being unknown goes, he's no different from them...
We don't have enough information...! Dammit.
But we pushed them back. Now, if any enemies remain, we hit them hard.
We can't let any more of them reach Earth...!
Quite the entertaining show! But I'm not so easily beaten.
Fuhyo-hohoho!
Is it over?
No other readings in this area... Looks like it's over.
But... the Gaizok battleship made it to Earth...
After all that... it's so annoying.
Against that force, we're lucky only one ship got through.
It may sound irresponsible, but... you're right. You really are.
Building up our forces is urgent, then.
If we had two or three more machines with real punch, it'd be different...
Excellen, come on. We don't have the pilots.
Hmmm, maybe we load in some AI?
Brooding won't get us anywhere.
Once all hands are back aboard, the Ra Cailum heads for the next point!
